description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars or fortune claims. Call when the user asks 我今天怎么样 / 我今天下午适不适合见面 / 未时基调 / 我的日主和今天什么关系 / my day. Personalized: day-master vs today's stem (十神) + optional hour pillar. Requires BALANCE_API_KEY + birth profile. Empty key → error personal_timetable_requires_key; use free tools instead. Not a fortune verdict.

birth.description: Optional birth profile. If omitted, uses the cloud profile saved on the paid account.

city.description: Birth city name, or pass longitude+latitude instead

time.description: Birth time HH:MM (local civil time on the birth certificate)

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

hour.description: Clock HH:MM or earthly branch 子–亥 (e.g. 14:30 or 未). Adds hour-pillar ten-god.
